caveat: Like-for-like replacement of existing roofing on a single-family dwelling costing $40,000 or less does not require a building permit under N.C.G.S. 160D-1110(c) (addition of roofing is carved in; replacement is carved out). NC OSFM guidance (10/19/2023) reads the exemption as replacement of roofing plus up to 15% of existing roof deck. A permit is still required if cost exceeds $40,000, load-bearing structure is added/repaired/replaced beyond that deck allowance, or new roofing is added. If a permit is issued, LUESA Section II.A applies ($59.70 + $12.19/$1,000 over $3,000) plus a $3 technology charge.

sourceName: Chicago 2026 Amended Building Permit Fee Tables; Table 14A-12-1204.2; EPP porch instructions
caveat: Typical new attached deck needs a permit. Code lists $300 stand-alone for new ≤6 ft decks, but Express still sends new structures to plan-based review ($602 minimum). Cosmetic board replacement with no violation is exempt.
calculationNote: Low $300 = Table 14A-12-1204.2. Typical/high $602 = plan-based minimum. Valuation unused.

extras.name: Stand-alone interior alteration ≤2,000 sf in one unit
extras.note: Table 14A-12-1204.2; included as typical. Zoning fee extra, not in DOB tables.

extras.name: Plumbing fixture replacement (no in-wall piping)
extras.note: Extra if plumbing is in scope; not in totals.

sourceName: Chicago Table 14A-12-1204.2 stand-alone fees; 2026 Amended Fee Tables
caveat: Cabinets/counters/paint with no plumbing or electrical connections are exempt ($0). A real kitchen with MEP uses stand-alone interior alteration ($250 ≤500 sf or $500 ≤2,000 sf). Gutting walls is plan-based ($602 min).
calculationNote: Low $0 = cosmetic exemption. Typical $500 = stand-alone interior ≤2,000 sf. High $602 = plan-based Level 2 floor. Valuation unused.

extras.name: Administrative fee
extras.note: On every permit; cannot compute structural line without roof/building sf.

extras.name: Minimum permit
extras.note: Floor before admin. 1-2 family reroof is 20% of Type VB new-construction fee by aggregate sf.

sourceName: City of Houston 2026 BCE Permit Fee Schedule (Type VB p. 8); CE-1109; CE-1059 20% rule
caveat: Permit required except roof covering ≤100 sf. Official 1-2 family formula is square footage (20% of Type VB new fee), not job valuation. Cannot convert $8k/$12k/$22k. Illustrative 20%+min+admin: 500 sf = $124.62; 1,500 sf = $230.78.
calculationNote: Fees null: Houston residential reroof is sf-based. Type VB new = $47 + $5.36 × ceil((sf−57.16)/8.17) in Tier 2; remodel = 20%; then max(result, $91.06) + $33.56.

extras.name: Repairs/alterations to existing HVAC (2% of valuation + $47)
Alternate complete-system line
extras.note: 3-ton at $11.41/ton + $47, then min + admin. Not used; does not consume assigned valuations.

sourceName: City of Houston 2026 BCE Permit Fee Schedule p. 3 HVAC; CE-1017 (Jan 2026)
caveat: Totals use the published 2%-of-valuation alteration line plus admin. Filing as a complete new system is billed per ton and usually pays only the $91.06+$33.56 floor. Portable appliances / minor part replacement are exempt.

extras.name: Minimum permit
extras.note: New accessory uses full Type VB new-construction table by deck sf, not 20%.

sourceName: HPC Plan Review exemptions; 2026 BCE fee schedule Type VB; Houston IRC R105.2
caveat: Typical attached deck >30 in. needs a permit. Exempt if uncovered, ≤30 in., not over a story/basement (HPC list) or ≤200 sf, ≤30 in., not attached, not serving the required exit (R105.2). Fee is by construction type and sf, not valuation.
calculationNote: Fees null. Illustrative Type VB new + admin: 200 sf = $177.04; 400 sf = $305.68.

extras.name: Structural floor (min + admin)
extras.note: Most kitchen-only areas stay on $91.06+$33.56 until ~700 sf of altered area.

extras.name: Plumbing minimum + admin
extras.note: If fixtures change. Not in totals.

extras.name: Electrical minimum + admin
extras.note: If electrical work. Not in totals.

sourceName: 2026 BCE Permit Fee Schedule; CE-1059 20% remodel rule
caveat: Cabinets/counters/paint without fixture or electrical work are exempt. Structural dollars are sf-based, so $15k/$35k/$75k cannot be mapped. Finish-only = $0 structural.
calculationNote: Structural fees null. Worked Type VB 20%: 400 sf → min $91.06 + $33.56 = $124.62; 1,000 sf → $167.31.

extras.name: Energy 10%
extras.note: Table 1-A footnote 2; residential re-roof >50% is Title 24. Included.

sourceName: LAMC Table 1-A (Ord. 185,587) and LADBS P/GI 2026-003 Express Permits
caveat: City of Los Angeles, not LA County. Express re-roof (Class A/B <6 psf over solid sheathing), no plan check. Uses published 2018 Table 1-A dollars; LAMC 91.107.1.1 CPI may apply in the live calculator. Heavy tile/structural adds 90% plan check.

extras.name: HVAC Fee Sch. 3 two-item minimum
extras.note: Furnace $19 + AC ≤25 HP $24 = $43 → $90 minimum for 2+ items.

extras.name: Separate electrical minimum
extras.note: If a new 240 V circuit is added. Included only in high.

sourceName: LADBS HVAC Permit Fee Schedule (Fee Sch. 3, 7/2017) + P/GI 2026-003
caveat: Per-item, not valuation. Posted 7/2017 schedule is still the LADBS fee-index PDF. SMIP/CBSC omitted (no valuation on this form).
calculationNote: Furnace $19 + AC $24 → min $90 + $2.70 + $5.40 = $98.10 at all three valuations. High adds electrical min $59.95 → $158.05.

extras.name: Plan check 90%
extras.note: New decks are not express. Included.

sourceName: LAMC Table 1-A and 91.107.3.1.1 plan check 90%
caveat: New decks are not on the express list. LAMC 91.106.2(4) exempts platforms ≤30 in. above grade and not over a basement/story. Energy 10% not applied (unconditioned).

extras.name: Fire hydrant 0.22%
extras.note: Only at $75,000 high (≥$50k). Included in high only.

sourceName: LAMC Table 1-A, P/GI 2026-003 I.2, plumbing Sch. 5, electrical fee schedule
caveat: Express only if no structural change. Structural kitchen adds 90% plan check. Fixture counts above plumbing/electrical minima would raise those trades.

sourceName: City of Dallas Permit Fee Schedule effective July 1, 2025 (Tables B-II / B-I) and Chapter 52
caveat: SF/duplex master uses Table B-II $181 + $15. B-I is the high bound if processed as a standalone trade permit. Exempt only if ≤2 roofing squares.
calculationNote: Typical B-II: $181+$15=$196 at all three valuations. High B-I at $22k: $282.42+$125+$15=$422.42.

sourceName: Dallas Table B-I (standalone trade permits) and Chapter 52 §301.2.3 / §303.5.29
caveat: 301.2.3(8) exempts like-for-like permanent electric HVAC with no rough-in change. Typical gas furnace + AC is not that exemption.

sourceName: Dallas Chapter 52 §301.2.1(13), Table B-II / B-I, technology $15
caveat: Exemption 301.2.1(13) only if all of: ≤200 sf, ≤30 in., not attached to the dwelling, not under a service drop, does not serve the required exit. Typical attached deck uses B-II $196.

sourceName: Dallas Tables B-II and B-I; Chapter 52 §301.2.1(1)(8), §303.2.1.1
caveat: Cabinets/countertops/paint/flooring only → building permit not required. Typical path is B-II master with extra trades. High is B-I valuation with 3 trades.

extras.name: City permit (0.50%, min $110)
extras.note: Included. 0.50% of $12,000 is $60, so the $110 minimum applies.

extras.name: Miami-Dade §8-12(e) $0.60/$1,000
extras.note: Collected by the city; not printed as a dollar rate in Exhibit C. Included.

sourceName: City of Miami Exhibit C (R-26-0200, Apr 23, 2026) plus F.S. 553.721 / 468.631 and Miami-Dade 8-12(e)
caveat: City of Miami (folio prefix 01), not Miami-Dade RER. Exhibit C PDF was not downloadable from this host (403); 0.50% / $110 min / $40 application are from the city's published Exhibit C as extracted. SAVE 50% city-fee cut not assumed.

sourceName: City of Miami Exhibit C + F.S. surcharges + Miami-Dade 8-12(e)
caveat: All three assumed values exceed the $2,500 mechanical-repair exemption. Easy Permit like-for-like still pays the same percentage.

sourceName: City of Miami Exhibit C and Work Exempt from Permit (Sec. 10-5)
caveat: Decks are not on the city exempt list. Playground equipment is. Energy $0.11/sf is new construction/addition only.

sourceName: City of Miami Exhibit C and Work Exempt from Permit
caveat: Cabinets/countertops-only in 1-2 family with no plumbing, electrical, or load-bearing changes is exempt. Totals assume a full remodel with MEP.

extras.name: $10 per $1,000 of estimated cost
extras.note: At $12,000. Included. Ceil used when valuation is not a round thousand.

sourceName: City of Boston ISD Building Fees (5/15/2023) + Repair A Roof
caveat: Covering-only reroof is short-form. Structural sheathing/framing is long-form ($50 + $10/$1,000). Schedule PDF is dated May 15, 2023 and was still posted 2026-09-01.

extras.name: Sheet metal minimum (first 200 lin/sq ft)
extras.note: $20 primary + $25. Low only; duct area unknown.

extras.name: Gas furnace/heater
extras.note: $20 + $50 each + $0.09 per 1,000 BTU. BTU rating not in the official project definition — not dollarized.

extras.name: Electrical
extras.note: $20 + $1/outlet or $0.25/amp if new circuit. Not dollarized.

sourceName: Boston ISD Building Fees 5/15/2023; Gas Permits; Sheet Metal Permits
caveat: ISD has no dedicated HVAC replacement page. Gas furnace uses $20+$50+$0.09/kBTU; sheet metal is $20+$25/200 lf or sf. Typical cannot be closed without BTU and duct area. Electrical extra if a new circuit.
calculationNote: Low = sheet-metal minimum $45. Typical/high left null (BTU and duct area not official).

sourceName: Boston ISD Long-Form Permits + Building Fees 5/15/2023
caveat: New structural work is long-form. Repair with original stamped plans can be short-form. Microfilming $3/sheet extra if plans filed.

extras.name: Plumbing / electrical / gas / sheet metal
extras.note: Unit counts unpublished. Not in totals.

sourceName: Boston ISD Kitchen/Bath remodel + Building Fees 5/15/2023
caveat: Totals are building permit only. A kitchen with sink/range/wiring adds trade permits that cannot be closed without fixture/outlet counts.

extras.name: City $3 + PA state $4.50
extras.note: On every permit. Included. $25 filing fee is credited.

sourceName: L&I Summary of construction permit fees, effective 1/1/2025 (PG_012_INF Rev 2.2026)
caveat: $69 is replacement-only. Structural roof work is billed as Alterations ($76 first 500 sf). Oct 1, 2026 PDF is published but not in force on 2026-09-01.

sourceName: L&I Get a Mechanical Permit + PG_012_INF 1/1/2025
caveat: Ordinary repairs/maintenance and small appliances are exempt. Like-for-like furnace/AC replacement is not. Electrical if a new circuit: $25 per $1,000 of electrical cost, min $63 + $7.50 — not in totals.

sourceName: L&I PG_012_INF 1/1/2025 + EZ permits page
caveat: Fee is by area, not assumed dollars. Under 500 sf the $8k/$12k/$19.2k valuations do not change the fee. Zoning permit is often required; zoning dollars not extracted. Roof decks are excluded from the 216 sf EZ standard.

extras.name: Electrical minimum
extras.note: Included in typical. Full electrical is $25 per $1,000 of electrical cost.

sourceName: L&I PG_012_INF 1/1/2025 + Get a Building Permit
caveat: Cabinets/countertops-only are building-permit exempt (non-historic). Default fee is area, not job cost. Optional 2% of construction (min $253) is applicant-requested and not used as typical. Electrical above the $63 minimum needs the electrical-contract amount.
calculationNote: Typical = $76+$50+$63+$22.50=$211.50. Low $0 = cabinets-only exemption. High left null (2% path + unknown electrical valuation).

extras.name: Roof re-sheathing SDU inspection
extras.note: If a permit is required (structure/diaphragm). Plan check hourly (IB 123). Not in totals.

extras.name: Roof structure replacement PC+insp per 2,000 sf

sourceName: DSD IB 123 + SDMC §129.0203 + When is a Permit Required
caveat: Official exemption: like-for-like covering replacement with no roof-structure/diaphragm alteration (SDMC §129.0203(a)(16); IB 123). Historic sites, covering >6 psf, or structural framing/sheathing beyond the 25% in-kind allowance need a permit. High left null (hourly plan check hours unpublished).

extras.name: Condensing unit (HVAC)
extras.note: Included in typical. Low = this line alone.

extras.name: Air handler / mini-split
extras.note: Included in high with furnace + condenser.

sourceName: DSD IB 103 Table 1B + What Permits Do I Need
caveat: Installing/replacing HVAC is Simple MEP, not the repair-only exemption. Valuation unused. Simple MEP: no plans, so no General Plan Maintenance Fee.
calculationNote: Typical furnace $176.57 + condenser $131.52 = $308.09. Low condenser-only $131.52. High + air handler $484.66.

extras.name: Mapping + collection + building standards + seismic on $12k

sourceName: DSD IB 501 Aug 2026 Table 501C + admin/state fees in IB 501
caveat: Decks are not in SDMC 129.0203 exemptions. GPMF $737 is included because plan review is required; confirm at intake whether Table 501C miscellaneous items actually assess it. Assumed dollars only affect seismic ($0.13/$1,000).

extras.name: IB 103 Table 3A kitchen/bath remodel per dwelling unit
extras.note: Includes no-plan plumbing/mechanical/electrical combo. Included as typical.

extras.name: Table 501A Res-SDU add/remodel first 500 sf (if framing)
extras.note: PC $3,512.92 + insp $2,228.29. Included in high with GPMF and state fees.

sourceName: DSD IB 103 Table 3A + IB 203 + IB 501 Table 501A
caveat: Cabinet/countertop relocation in Group R-3 is building-permit exempt. Typical no-plan combo uses only the labeled $440.82; unclear whether IB 501C $529.71 building inspection stacks. High assumes ≤500 sf with framing plus GPMF.

sourceName: City of Las Vegas Building and Safety, 2020 Building User Fees (eff. July 1, 2021)
caveat: City of Las Vegas, not Clark County. Typical tear-off/tile requires a permit. Non-tile covering replacement with no structural work and ≤64 sf sheathing is officially exempt. Fees do not vary with $8k/$12k/$22k. Posted tables remain effective July 1, 2021.
calculationNote: $68+$119+$55=$242 at all three valuations. Structure/sheathing path $125+$101+$55=$281.

extras.name: Table 3-D #15 HVAC Exact change out plan check

sourceName: City of Las Vegas Building and Safety, Table 3-D MPE Fees (eff. July 1, 2021)
caveat: Permit required to install or change any part of a heating/cooling system. Minor part / filter / portable units exempt. Not valuation-based.

sourceName: City of Las Vegas Building and Safety, Table 3-E (eff. July 1, 2021)
caveat: Permit required if the deck is more than 30 inches above grade. Fee is per deck, not by valuation.

extras.name: Table 3-A #68 remodel with MPE at 200 sf (PC+insp)

sourceName: City of Las Vegas Building and Safety, Table 3-A R-3 Remodel (eff. July 1, 2021)
caveat: Cabinets/countertops/finish-only are exempt. City prices remodel by affected square feet, not valuation. Cannot compute $15k/$35k/$75k without inventing SF.
calculationNote: No official valuation formula. Published SF rows only: 200/500/1000/1400/2000 sf.

sourceName: DC DOB permit exemptions (12-A DCMR § 105.2) and Building Permit Fee Schedule
caveat: Like-kind roofing/coping is exempt outside historic districts and floodplain. Historic 105.2.5 requires a permit; then use the alteration formula. Material change is not in-kind.

sourceName: DC DOB Building Permit Fee Schedule; Instant Permits
caveat: Replacement HVAC requires a permit. Typical one unit ≤10 tons is Instant Mechanical $50.60, not 2% of contract. High is the alteration path at $16k if Instant does not apply. Trades can stack.

extras.name: Building plat (new decks)
extras.note: DOB Surveyor. Not in the three fee fields.

sourceName: DC DOB Deck Permit FAQ and Building Permit Fee Schedule
caveat: DOB Deck FAQ prices ($30+2%V)×1.10 only; does not add the green fee. Plat required for new decks. Historic/CFA may add review.

extras.name: Plumbing first fixture ($26+10%)
extras.note: Not in totals; fixture counts not assumed.

sourceName: DC DOB Building Permit Fee Schedule (alteration/repair); 12-M DCMR §§ 100.2, 101.1
caveat: Cabinets/countertops/finish-only exempt. Typical remodel is Alteration & Repair. Plumbing/electrical unit fees extra; fixture counts not assumed. Green included from the alteration schedule.
